meta.name: decompose-work
meta.description: Break approved product scope and architecture artifacts into epics, user stories, implementation tasks, dependency graph, critical path, ownership map, validation packs, merge order, and parallelization plan. Use after requirements and architecture are approved and before assigning implementation agents, opening parallel work, or writing artifacts `24-epics.md` through `29-agent-role-matrix.md`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解产品范围，生成可并行的开发任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你已有确认的需求与架构，正需拆解成可执行的开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Decompose approved product scope into epics, user stories, and execution tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have approved scope and need to split it into tasks

howto.what: 将已批准的需求和架构分解为 epics、用户故事、任务，构建依赖图与关键路径，规划并行任务、合并顺序和验证方式，并为每个任务指定负责人和写范围。
howto.when: 在需求和架构批准后、分配实现代理或开启并行工作之前触发。当用户要求拆解工作或进入实施规划时接管。

say.text: 请把当前需求拆成 epics 和任务。
根据架构产出依赖图和关键路径。
规划并行任务并给出合并顺序。

howto.what_en: Break approved product scope and architecture into epics, user stories, tasks, dependency graph, critical path, validation packs, merge order, and parallelization plan, assigning owners and write scopes.
howto.when_en: Triggers after requirements and architecture are approved, before assigning implementation agents or opening parallel work.

say_en.text: Break the current requirements into epics and tasks.
Produce a dependency graph and critical path from the architecture.
Plan parallel tasks and give a merge order.
